System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.

Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 

Responsibilities:

  • Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

  • Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

  • Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

  • Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

  • Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

  • Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

  • Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in marketing, business or engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

  • Proven experience building product marketing from the ground up in a scale-up: hands-on, pragmatic and entrepreneurial, setting up processes, frameworks and tools with limited resources while delivering results.

  • Demonstrable experience in defining value propositions, positioning and go-to-market plans, and executing them through launches and sales enablement.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technology and translate it into clear, credible customer value.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of presenting to technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, and in analytics for funnel and performance reporting.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and international trade shows; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience in ASW, ISR or CUI-related defense technology markets, or with underwater acoustics, is a big plus.

  • Experience with defense procurement, tenders and export-controlled products.

  • Understanding of pricing and packaging for hardware, software and recurring-revenue (license or subscription) models.

  • Experience working with prime contractors and system integrators.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Miro, PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

We help churches develop. Behind every church are people who give their time and heart to their community, and we want to make their work easier. Our software brings administration and communication together in one platform, so there’s less time for paperwork and more time for people.

You’ve just graduated or are about to, or you have your first work experience behind you. At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. As a Mobile Developer, you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working.

Your role

As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain.

You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment.

  • You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications.

  • You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines.

  • You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.
